ctx.x: Now, I don't realize that De Fore Duflores (phonetic) was having problems with the black local there; local 208; that was before they merged, and they wanted him to put up so much money and he wouldn't do it. And when it was time to do a concert, what you call -- one of the delegates was trying to tell him, you can't play, you ain't gonna play and telling us not to play, and hell, I needed the money; I came all the way from New York to play this concert.

Anyway, we played. It wasn't a good turnout but we got paid; I got paid, you know, Griffin got paid, Phil Thomas got paid and Jody Jerry got paid and, Henry Richard Brown was the walking delegate; walking around with his [twisted] leg, you know, and that knocked the concerts out, because he

Rollins; couldn't contact Sonny Robinson; he was supposed to come in, Coltrane maybe about a week later, or two weeks later, and Cole Train was supposed to come in two or three weeks following that; you know, just as singles, to use our rhythm section. So, that folded.
